verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the platform is a fair question for a PaaS or deployment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Railway as a hosted cloud provider (deploy to the cloud, cloud agents on Railway machines). Nothing documents a self-hostable edition, install path, or source release. Local development with the CLI is not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
